name: topview-browser
description: Create, organize, and edit visual content in Topview Canvas using a browser-native workflow.

interface.shortDescription: Create and edit visual content in a browser-based Topview Canvas.
interface.longDescription: Topview provides a shared browser-based Canvas for you and your Agent to create, organize, and refine visual content. Keep characters, scenes, references, assets, and versions connected, generate images and videos with built-in creative Skills, and continue editing directly in the full Topview web Canvas.
defaultPrompt: Open my Topview Canvas in the browser and help me continue editing it.
Use my product assets to create short-form video ad concepts and organize them in Canvas.
Develop this story into a short film and keep the plot, characters, storyboards, and visual assets connected in Canvas.
